templates.name: Standard Workstation
templates.description: Baseline checklist for a newly configured desktop or laptop before handover.

tasks.title: Configuration profile applied and verified
tasks.description: Apply the selected profile and confirm that the drift detector reports no unexplained differences.

tasks.title: Winget is available for approved software
tasks.description: Winget is only needed if this build installs software from the approved catalog.

tasks.title: Windows Update checked
tasks.description: Review available updates on the Windows Update page. Installing updates is an explicit user action.

tasks.title: Devices and drivers reviewed
tasks.description: Check Device Manager findings and decide whether a driver action is appropriate. Do not install unknown drivers.

tasks.title: Security posture reviewed
tasks.description: Review Defender, Firewall, UAC, Secure Boot, TPM and BitLocker status. WinFirst never weakens these controls.

tasks.title: User data is backed up
tasks.description: Confirm a current backup exists before any destructive cleanup or removal.

tasks.title: Printer tested (if required)
tasks.description: Print a test page if the user relies on a printer.

tasks.title: Handover notes recorded
tasks.description: Record account ownership, exceptions and follow-up work in the session notes.

templates.name: Laptop Build
templates.description: Checklist for a portable system where battery, encryption and docking matter.

tasks.title: Laptop profile applied and verified
tasks.description: Use the Laptop Workstation profile or an approved custom profile and verify it with the drift detector.

tasks.title: Battery health checked
tasks.description: Review design capacity, full-charge capacity and estimated wear. Wear is an estimate.

tasks.title: Drive encryption reviewed
tasks.description: Confirm BitLocker status. Enabling or managing recovery keys is outside WinFirst's automatic actions.

tasks.title: Windows Update checked
tasks.description: Review update and pending-restart status.

tasks.title: Laptop devices and drivers reviewed
tasks.description: Check touchpad, camera, fingerprint, Wi-Fi and power-management devices for problem codes.

tasks.title: Dock, external display and wired network tested
tasks.description: Connect the dock and confirm display, USB and Ethernet behaviour.

tasks.title: User data is backed up
tasks.description: Confirm a current backup exists before any destructive action.

templates.name: IT Technician Bench
templates.description: Checklist for a technician bench machine used for diagnostics and repair.

tasks.title: Technician profile applied and verified
tasks.description: Apply the IT Technician Workstation profile or an approved custom profile.

tasks.title: WinFirst running with administrator rights
tasks.description: Many diagnostics and repairs require elevation. Review the elevated indicator before proceeding.

tasks.title: Diagnostic repository available
tasks.description: Inventory the portable toolkit and verify checksums before using any approved installer. Scripts are never executed by WinFirst.

tasks.title: System report exported
tasks.description: Generate an HTML or PDF report from the Reports page and store it with the job record.

tasks.title: Security posture reviewed
tasks.description: Review security findings, pending updates and activation status.

tasks.title: Target data backed up
tasks.description: Confirm the customer's data is backed up or that the job explicitly authorizes data loss.

tasks.title: Technician handover notes recorded
tasks.description: Record what was changed, what was not changed, and any follow-up required.
